description: SS 1411(c)(1)(B) properly-allocable deductions reduce net investment income (Form 8960 lines 9-10): single, wages 300,000, interest 5,000, LTCG 20,000, allocable investment expenses 1,500. NII = 25,000 - 1,500 = 23,500; MAGI excess over 200,000 = 125,000; lesser = 23,500 -> 3.8% = 893.00. Hand-computed.
